# OilRadar

> Satellite intelligence for physical crude oil supply. OilRadar tracks oil storage at Kharg Island and major Persian Gulf export terminals using Sentinel-1 SAR imagery, providing 4–7 weeks of lead time over official EIA and JODI reports.

OilRadar is a data intelligence product for commodity traders, macro hedge funds, and energy analysts who need early signals on physical crude oil supply before official data is published.

## What OilRadar Does

OilRadar processes Sentinel-1 SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) satellite imagery to measure the fill level of floating-roof oil storage tanks at major export terminals. Unlike AIS vessel tracking or official government statistics, SAR imagery directly observes physical oil inventories at the source — before any tanker moves.

## Key Facts

- **Lead time:** 4–7 weeks ahead of EIA, JODI, and IEA reports
- **Update frequency:** 2–3 times per week (Sentinel-1 pass schedule)
- **Primary coverage:** Kharg Island export terminal, Iran (operational since March 2023)
- **Expanding coverage:** Saudi Arabia, Iraq (Basra), Kuwait, UAE (Fujairah), Qatar
- **Methodology:** Floating roof tank shadow analysis via C-band SAR backscatter
- **Hit rate:** 86% accuracy on export bottleneck prediction when pre-event storage was rising
- **Insurance shock impact:** Average +0.41M bbl storage accumulation within 5 weeks of insurance premium spike
- **Sanctions lag:** Shadow fleet sanctions take 7 weeks to reach the exporter's berths in observed data

## How It Works

1. Sentinel-1 C-band radar images the terminal 2–3 times per week, penetrating clouds and darkness
2. Floating roof tanks cast measurable radar shadows — shadow geometry reveals whether each roof is up (full) or down (near empty)
3. Known tank diameter × fill ratio = approximate crude volume in million barrels
4. Storage dynamics (build vs. drawdown) reveal the export signal 4–7 weeks before market consensus

## Why Kharg Island

Kharg Island (Iran) handles approximately 90% of Iranian crude oil exports. It is the single most important choke point for Iranian supply. Storage builds at Kharg indicate export friction or tanker queuing; storage draws indicate active loading and supply entering the global market.

## Information Lag Comparison

| Source | Lag to market-moving signal |
|---|---|
| OilRadar (SAR) | 2–3 updates per week |
| AIS trackers | 1–2 weeks |
| Shipping agents | 2–4 weeks |
| EIA / JODI | 4–8 weeks |
| IEA Reports | 6–10 weeks |

## Products

- **Kharg Monitor** (`https://oilradar.io/monitor`): Live storage level dashboard updated 2–3x per week via Sentinel-1 SAR
- **Europe Gas Storage Monitor** (`https://oilradar.io/gas-storage`): Real-time GIE AGSI+ data across 10 European countries — primary leading indicator for TTF pricing and winter supply risk
- **Full Persian Gulf Dataset** (bespoke): All 6 major exporters (Saudi Arabia, Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, UAE, Qatar) at per-terminal, per-tank resolution
